sh_altar_place_armor: Place a valid armor to imbue
sh_item_elder_drop_desc: The emerald heart of The Elder.
sh_item_rune_barkskin_desc: Sacrifices stamina to gain that much armor up to a maximum amount. Quality increases maximum. Nature skill increases duration.
sh_item_rune_blink_desc:
Teleports you forwards.
Range: 15 (+5 per level)
sh_item_rune_chain_lightning_desc:
A bolt of lightning jumps to 5 targets.
Range: 15.
sh_item_rune_force_desc: Draw upon the might of the shield wall.
sh_item_rune_frostbolt_desc: Applies a slowing effect on impact.
sh_item_rune_goodberry_desc: Conjures a berry that you can eat.
sh_item_rune_heal_desc: Applies a Healing over Time effect to all allies within 10 yards of the player. Quality increases the amount healed and Nature skill increases duration.
sh_item_rune_immolate_desc: Invoke a flaming aura, burning enemies around you.
sh_item_rune_invigorate_desc: Instantly restores stamina and grants stamina over time.
sh_item_rune_light_desc: Summons a ball of light that follows you for 5 minutes.
sh_item_rune_recall_desc: Call upon the Valkyries to return you home.
sh_item_rune_travel_desc: Increases movement speed and drains mana while held.
sh_item_rune_warmth_desc: Increases health and stamina regen and makes you resistant to cold.
sh_item_rune_windfury_desc: Grants an chance to perform an extra attack when attacking with a melee weapon. Quality improves chance.
sh_se_rune_barskin_desc_detailed:
Increases armor by <color=orange>$1</color>.
Reduces stamina by <color=orange>$2%</color>.
Lasts for <color=orange>$3</color>.
sh_se_rune_windfury_desc: Grants a chance to perform an extra attack.
sh_se_rune_windfury_desc_detailed: Attacks have a <color=orange>$1%</color> to cause an extra attack.
